title: Keypoint series sidecar
description: Describes a pair of .npy files: keypoints float32 [T, K, 3] as (x, y, confidence) in pixels, and timestamps float64 [T] in seconds. Written by the app and every runner; read by the harness (ADR 0006 C5, ADR 0008 8c).

keypoint_indices.description: COCO-WholeBody index of each K column, in order.

image_size.description: [width, height] of the frames the coordinates refer to.

model_id.description: Readable name plus 8-hex content hash of the artifact (ADR 0006 C3).
